needs.source: TI SNOSBS0D: 'compensation with a single 30 pF capacitor' (description); the electrical characteristics apply for C1 = 30 pF (note 1); Figure 17 single-pole compensation CS = 30 pF; minimum values stable only for source resistances below 10 kΩ, strays below 5 pF and loads below 100 pF – else overcompensate (application hints)

hints: externally compensated: 30 pF between COMPENSATION (8) and BALANCE/COMPENSATION (1) for unity gain (Figure 17); more where the source resistance exceeds 10 kΩ, the summing junction sees more than 5 pF or the load more than 100 pF
the electrical characteristics hold for ±5 V ≤ VS ≤ ±15 V (note 1): below a total of 10 V – a 9 V pedal supply behind a diode – the datasheet guarantees nothing

compliance.source: TI SNOSBS0D: an operational amplifier, no transmitter – read 2026-10-31; RoHS and REACH not read

sources: TI LM101A/LM201A/LM301A Operational Amplifiers, SNOSBS0D (September 1999, revised March 2013), from TI https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm101a-n.pdf (the LM301A-N's data sheet – ti.com has no lm301a.pdf: /lit/ds/symlink/lm301a.pdf and /product/LM301A answer 404), read 2026-10-31; LCSC C22505 is TI LM301AN, DIP-8 (JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31 (edakit part search): Extended Part, no stock; LCSC's product page answers 'Page Not Found')

pins: Connection Diagrams, Figure 49 (CDIP and PDIP, NAB0008A or P0008E): 1 BALANCE/COMPENSATION, 2 INPUT (inverting), 3 INPUT (non-inverting), 4 V−, 5 BALANCE, 6 OUTPUT, 7 V+, 8 COMPENSATION – read from the drawing; V− typed ground with the role vee

vdd_max_v 36: Absolute Maximum Ratings, LM301A supply voltage ±18 V; vdd_op_min_v 10, vdd_op_max_v 30: Electrical Characteristics note 1, the specifications apply for ±5 V ≤ VS ≤ ±15 V (LM301A) – entered as the total supply

vin_rel_max_v 0 and v_min_v 0 on the inputs: Absolute Maximum Ratings input voltage ±15 V, note 3: for supply voltages less than ±15 V the absolute maximum input voltage is equal to the supply voltage

vicm_v [3, −3]: Electrical Characteristics, LM301A input voltage range ±12 V minimum at VS = ±15 V (typical +15, −13) – 3 V from each rail; vout_swing_v [3, −3]: output voltage swing ±12 V minimum at ±15 V, RL = 10 kΩ
iq_a 0.003: supply current 3.0 mA maximum (1.8 typical) at VS = ±15 V, 25 °C
gain_min_ratio 1 with the need of 30 pF between pins 8 and 1: the description ('compensation with a single 30 pF capacitor'), note 1 (C1 = 30 pF), Figure 17 single-pole compensation CS = 30 pF
tj_max_c 100: Absolute Maximum Ratings, LM301A TJ max (P0008E); rth_ja_k_per_w 135: θJA typical, P0008E; t_min_c 0, t_max_c 70: operating ambient range of the LM301A
notes: General-purpose op-amp, externally compensated – the Rat's gain stage (30 pF across pins 8 and 1). Library draft.

checked: Figure 49: PDIP pinout 1 BALANCE/COMPENSATION, 2 IN−, 3 IN+, 4 V−, 5 BALANCE, 6 OUTPUT, 7 V+, 8 COMPENSATION
Absolute Maximum Ratings: ±18 V, input ±15 V or the supply below it, TJ 100 °C, θJA 135 °C/W (P0008E)
